ACME Ops: We're seeing intermittent 504s on /v1/embeddings for large batched requests (8-12MB). Started ~09:12 UTC and affects ~30% of attempts. SDK shows retry fanout and customers report double billing. Example curl response header: `x-request-id: rq_71823_01` — any quick suggestions?

Jess: Thanks — can you paste the full `x-request-id` and SDK version? Also, do you have a minimal repro script?

ACME Ops: request_id: rq_71823_01, SDK v1.4.2, repro: we send 1k short texts then one 10MB batch. Token refresh rotates at same time (every 15m). Attached snippet: `python repro.py --batch large_batch.json`.

Sam (SDK): Noted. v1.4.2 has a known edge-case where token refresh can open new conns without draining old ones, leaving half-closed sockets. That can exhaust keepalive slots at our edge -> 504 upstream reset. Quick try: set env `REDWOOD_SDK_KEEPALIVE=60` and reduce client concurrency to confirm. Also enable SDK debug logs (`REDWOOD_SDK_LOG=debug`).

Alex (SRE): From edge traces we see `upstream prematurely closed connection` matching that behavior. There's also a spike in concurrent idle connections from ACME tenant around the timestamps you provided. Can you temporarily run with `--max-concurrency=8`? We'll provision a small increase in edge connection window for that tenant.

Indra (Eng): Looking at runtime logs, large embed serialization holds a KV cache lock longer than usual for 10MB payloads. While lock is held, the request stalls and proxy times out. We're preparing a micro-patch to reduce lock hold time and stream serialization. Rolling canary in 20m.

ACME Ops: Any ETA on canary? Also customers flagged unexpected duplicate token billing for failed attempts.

Jess: We'll open a billing hold immediately and create a support ticket for credits. Ticket SUP-4572 created and billing alerted. Canary rollout to subset of edges starts in ~20m, monitoring p95.

Sam (SDK): In parallel, try `pip install redwood-sdk==1.4.3b1` (beta) — it has a drain fix + exponential jitter on token refresh that prevents retry storms. Command: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.4.3b1`

ACME Ops: Installed beta, running repro for 15 mins — no 504s so far. Client retries look dampened. Good sign.

Alex (SRE): Great. We'll watch metrics for 2 hours (p95 tokens, connection count, 504 rate). If stable we'll promote the patch and coordinate with SDK team for public release.

Indra (Eng): Following canary we plan to merge the KV serialization streaming change and a small keepalive tweak at the gateway. Postmortem and changelog entry will follow.

support-bot: incident created INC-71823, severity: P2, owners: eng-sre, sdk-team.

Jess: Billing hold in place, engineering patching underway, updated timeline in incident. :thumbsup:

ACME Ops: Thanks all — beta looks promising. Please ping here when canary promoted so we can roll to prod clients.

Alex (SRE): Will do — next update in 20m after canary metrics settle.

ACME Ops: appreciate the quick turnaround, leaving logs in the ticket for follow-up.
